items.name: Roy
items.summary: An AI royalty-statement analyst for musicians and publishers that I designed, built and run end to end.
items.problem: Royalty statements come in dozens of inconsistent formats.
built: The whole product, solo: product and design, Next.js frontend and API routes, Supabase Postgres database and migrations, Clerk auth, Gemini-powered analysis and chat, Vercel deployment, and day-to-day live operations.
A statement parser that uploads, normalizes and analyzes royalty statements across 37 formats.
CI with Vitest unit tests and Playwright end-to-end tests gating every pull request.
results: 100% parsing accuracy across 37 statement formats, verified in CI on every change.
Built with AI-agent-driven development behind PR checks.

items.name: Sensational Concrete
items.summary: The website for a local concrete contractor, which I designed, built and run end to end.
built: The whole site: design, Next.js frontend, a quote-request API that emails leads to the owner via Resend, Vercel deployment and analytics, and ongoing operations.
Structured data and generative-engine optimization so AI assistants like ChatGPT can understand and cite the business. The owner reports leads from ChatGPT users.
Lead-source tracking on the quote form ("How did you hear about us?" plus UTM capture).
CI with lint, type checks, build, quote-form tests and an SEO check.

agents.text: I run a small team of AI agents across engineering, finance and marketing. Every change goes through pull requests, automated tests and CI guardrails, and I verify the results myself before anything ships.
